source: Dummy provider decision matrix seed mirrored from manual-work-queue.md. Candidates are placeholders for Dawson validation; no production vendor is approved by this file.
notes: This seed is intentionally metadata-only: no account data, measurements, credentials, tokens, raw errors, analytics events, device identifiers, or private notes.
Every row remains review-gated until Dawson approves a provider, keeps the feature disabled, or removes the feature from launch scope.

decisions.label: Product analytics provider
decisionNeeded: Decide whether production product analytics are acceptable at all.
Approve self-hosted or first-party hosting if analytics are enabled.
Confirm retention, access, and deletion policy before launch.
privacyRequirements: Disabled by default unless the launch decision record explicitly enables upload.
No measurements, account emails, names, goals, notes, photos, sync tokens, or free-form properties.
Only allowlisted event names, anonymous session IDs, sanitized routes, and browser metadata.
currentScaffold: backend repositories and POST /api/product-analytics first-party sink
verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_api.py tests/test_repositories.py

candidates.label: Keep analytics upload disabled
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; current prototype default
notes: Keeps local usage events only and avoids external analytics review for launch.
Still requires a clear launch decision so copy and privacy terms match behavior.

candidates.label: Self-hosted analytics provider
candidates.reviewStatus: needs privacy, hosting, and retention review
notes: Candidate slot for a self-hosted product analytics tool.
Must accept only the minimized first-party envelope.

decisions.label: Client error monitoring provider
decisionNeeded: Decide whether browser error uploads should be enabled in production.
Approve first-party-only storage or a self-hosted error tracker.
Set retention and human-access policy for sanitized error records.
privacyRequirements: Raw error messages, stacks, measurements, form payloads, account emails, and notes must not leave the browser.
Upload must stay opt-in or environment-gated until provider review is complete.
Local ring buffer must remain clearable by the user.
verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_api.py tests/test_repositories.py

candidates.label: First-party sanitized error sink
candidates.reviewStatus: needs retention and access review
notes: Uses the existing API without sending raw stacks or user payload fields.
Still needs production storage, deletion, and access rules.

candidates.label: Self-hosted error tracker
candidates.reviewStatus: needs privacy and deployment review
notes: Candidate slot for a Sentry-compatible or similar tracker.
Must be configured to receive only the sanitized client-error envelope.

decisions.label: Magic-link email provider
decisionNeeded: Approve production email delivery provider for magic links.
Decide account recovery and support flow.
Confirm whether identity-linked sync is in launch scope.
privacyRequirements: Raw login tokens must never be returned by production JSON responses.
Email addresses must stay out of analytics, error reports, share dashboards, and sync-vault blobs.
Sessions and magic-link secrets must stay hash-stored.
verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_account_email.py tests/test_api.py tests/test_repositories.py

candidates.label: Development token mode only
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; local development only
notes: Useful for local tests and persona walkthroughs.
Must not be enabled for a public deployment.

candidates.label: SMTP transactional email provider
candidates.reviewStatus: needs provider, deliverability, and privacy review
notes: Uses the existing SMTP-capable scaffold.
Requires sender domain, bounce handling, and recovery/support decisions.

decisions.label: Web billing provider
decisionNeeded: Approve whether Pro billing is in launch scope.
Select checkout, tax, refund, entitlement, and support workflow.
Confirm pricing and free-feature boundaries.
privacyRequirements: Measurements, notes, photos, and sync tokens must not be sent to checkout or billing webhooks.
Entitlement records must be separable from local measurement logs.
Pro waitlist data must remain local until account and billing providers are approved.
currentScaffold: frontend local Pro waitlist and referral credits
all current user-data tools remain non-gated

candidates.label: Keep paid billing out of launch scope
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; current prototype default
notes: Keeps all current tools available without checkout risk.
Still requires pricing copy to avoid promising unavailable Pro behavior.

candidates.label: Hosted web checkout provider
candidates.reviewStatus: needs billing, tax, privacy, and support review
notes: Candidate slot for web subscriptions.
Requires account identity linkage and webhook verification design.

decisions.label: Native in-app purchase provider
decisionNeeded: Decide whether native Pro purchase is in the first store release.
Approve Apple/Google account setup, product IDs, pricing, and entitlement restore flow.
Confirm parity with any web checkout plan.
privacyRequirements: Purchase records must not include body measurements, notes, photos, or strategy choices.
Native receipt handling must be tied to explicit account identity and revocation policy.
Store copy must not imply medical, diagnostic, or guaranteed outcome features.
currentScaffold: Capacitor config and native package scripts
entitlement catalog and local referral records
No generated Android/iOS project folders yet

candidates.label: Keep native IAP out of launch scope
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; current prototype default
notes: Lets native builds ship as free/local-first if store policy permits.
Requires copy cleanup for Pro previews and referrals.

candidates.label: Store in-app purchase integration
candidates.reviewStatus: needs native project, billing, and store-policy review
notes: Requires generated native project folders and real device validation.
Needs entitlement restore and account recovery policy.

decisions.label: Web and native push delivery
decisionNeeded: Configure production VAPID, FCM, and APNs credentials or keep remote delivery disabled.
Validate web and native subscription flows on real devices.
Approve reminder copy and opt-out behavior.
privacyRequirements: Reminder payloads must remain generic and timestamp-only.
Device tokens and endpoint hashes must not be exposed in exports, analytics, share dashboards, or logs.
No measurement values, goals, notes, or account emails in notification payloads.
currentScaffold: backend web/native push repositories and dry-run workers
verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_api.py tests/test_native_push.py tests/test_repositories.py

candidates.label: Local browser reminders only
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; current fallback path
notes: Avoids remote push provider setup while preserving local decay reminders.
Does not cover native background delivery.

candidates.label: Remote web/native push providers
candidates.reviewStatus: needs credential, device, and privacy review
notes: Uses existing timestamp-only scheduling scaffolds.
Requires production credentials and end-to-end device testing.

decisions.label: Live-update provider and signing
decisionNeeded: Approve provider, signing, staged rollout, and rollback policy.
Decide whether live updates are allowed for the first native release.
Define store-review boundaries for server-driven changes.
privacyRequirements: Update checks must remain release metadata only.
No account identifiers, measurements, notes, device tokens, or sync tokens in manifest requests.
Rollback metadata must not expose user state.

candidates.label: Store releases only
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; conservative default
notes: Avoids live-update signing and provider policy work for first release.
Keeps the manifest as a release-readiness check only.

candidates.label: Signed live-update provider
candidates.reviewStatus: needs provider, signing, rollback, and store-policy review
notes: Candidate slot for OTA web bundle updates.
Requires native project folders, signing keys, and staged rollout process.

decisions.label: HealthKit / Health Connect provider path
decisionNeeded: Approve native health plugin, permissions, and store disclosure wording.
Decide write-only preview versus real read/write sync scope.
Validate on real iOS and Android devices after native project generation.
privacyRequirements: Health preview state must remain metadata-only.
No account emails, notes, food names, photos, or raw measurement arrays in preview persistence.
Actual native writes must require explicit user action and platform permission.
currentScaffold: No native HealthKit/Health Connect plugin wiring yet

candidates.label: Keep metadata-only write preview
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; current prototype default
notes: Keeps health sync visible without requesting platform permissions.
Requires copy that clearly says no health data was written.

candidates.label: Native health plugins
candidates.reviewStatus: needs native project, permission, device, and policy review
notes: Requires generated Android/iOS project folders and real device validation.
Needs platform-specific disclosures and recovery behavior.

decisions.label: Cloud backup and cross-device sync provider
decisionNeeded: Decide whether automatic cross-device sync is in launch scope.
Approve provider-backed background sync or keep manual encrypted files only.
Define recovery, merge, device revocation, and support policy.
privacyRequirements: Backend and cloud providers must receive only opaque encrypted blobs.
Passphrases, sync tokens, account emails, notes, photos, and measurement keys must not be sent in sync bodies.
Manual export/delete must stay available with or without an account.
currentScaffold: token-scoped encrypted sync-vault API and account-panel manual flow
verification: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/test_api.py tests/test_repositories.py

candidates.label: Manual encrypted files only
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; current prototype default
notes: Keeps recovery user-controlled and avoids background provider assumptions.
Does not solve automatic multi-device sync.

candidates.label: First-party opaque sync vault
candidates.reviewStatus: needs account recovery, deletion, and provider review
notes: Uses the existing encrypted sync-vault API.
Requires production identity, recovery, and support process.

candidates.label: Native cloud drive backup
candidates.reviewStatus: needs native project and platform-policy review
notes: Candidate for iCloud/Google Drive style encrypted backup storage.
Requires generated native project folders and platform entitlement review.

decisions.label: AI data explainer provider
decisionNeeded: Approve production model provider or keep the local deterministic preview only.
Review prompt-boundary wording for medical, dosing, diagnosis, and prescribing limits.
Decide whether the feature is Pro-gated and how logs are excluded from prompts.
privacyRequirements: Account emails, account IDs, private notes, sync tokens, photos, and raw face data must not be sent to a model provider.
Medical, dosing, prescribing, and diagnosis requests must stay refusal/boundary cases.
Corpus citations must be context only and not personalized medical advice.

candidates.label: Local deterministic preview only
candidates.reviewStatus: review before production; current prototype default
notes: Avoids external model upload while preserving UI and prompt-boundary tests.
Requires final copy review so users do not expect generative advice.

candidates.label: Production model provider
candidates.reviewStatus: needs privacy, prompt, legal, and Pro-gating review
notes: Candidate slot for a hosted model.
Requires strict prompt minimization and high-risk request handling before launch.
